title: Remedies
today_line: =TEXT(taken_today) & " of " & TEXT(total) & " taken" & IF(missed_today > 0, ", " & TEXT(missed_today) & " missed", "")
done_line: =IF(missed_today = 0, "All taken today", "Every cup marked for today")
week_line: =IF(week_marked = 0, "Nothing marked this week yet", TEXT(week_taken) & " of " & TEXT(week_marked) & " marked this week were taken")
